summary.text: Pam Howard is the Democratic candidate for the Alabama House of Representatives, District 40, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces incumbent Republican Chad Robertson.

paragraphs.text: Howard was unopposed for the Democratic nomination, as the District 40 primary scheduled for May 19, 2026, was canceled.
She also faced Robertson in the November 8, 2022, general election for the same seat, which Robertson won.
